news.titleEn: 10-year Treasury yield climbs back to 5% after Fed hikes rates, Warsh highlights inflation risks
news.conclusionEn: The Fed raised rates and Chair Kevin Warsh flagged persistent inflation, pushing the 10-year Treasury yield back to about 5%.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储加息且沃什强调通胀风险，10年期美债收益率回升至约5%。
news.whyEn: A 5% benchmark yield lifts mortgage, corporate and government borrowing costs and pressures equity valuations globally.
news.whyZh: 5%的基准收益率推高房贷、企业和政府融资成本，并压制全球股市估值。
news.detailEn: After the Fed's first rate hike in about three years, Warsh said this summer's inflation readings do not show underlying improvement and suggested more hikes could be warranted. Bond yields jumped in response, with the 10-year note moving above the 5% mark that had been a key threshold for markets. Higher yields compete with stocks for investor money and raise financing costs across the economy. Markets will now watch upcoming inflation data for signs of whether further tightening is coming.
news.detailZh: 这是美联储约三年来首次加息。沃什表示今夏通胀数据并未显示基本面改善，并暗示可能需要继续加息。债市随之下挫，10年期收益率升破市场关注的5%关口。高收益率会分流股市资金并抬高全社会融资成本。接下来市场将紧盯通胀数据，判断是否会继续收紧。

news.titleEn: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500 post weekly losses as 10-year Treasury yield hovers near 5%
news.conclusionEn: Wall Street ended a choppy week mixed, with the Dow down about 1.5% on the week while the Nasdaq gained.
news.conclusionZh: 华尔街本周震荡收官，道指周跌约1.5%，纳指周涨。
news.whyEn: Rising yields and oil-driven inflation worries are shaping the outlook for stocks, rates and the dollar worldwide.
news.whyZh: 收益率上行与油价推动的通胀担忧正在左右全球股市、利率和美元走势。
news.detailEn: On Friday the S&P 500 rose 0.17% to about 7,650 and the Nasdaq added 0.39%, while the Dow slipped 0.18% and finished the week down over 1.5%. The 10-year yield hovered near 5% as traders priced in more Fed hikes. JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon said it is not clear inflation has been beaten. Oil dipping below $100 offered some relief but did not change the broader rate worries.
news.detailZh: 周五标普500上涨0.17%至约7650点，纳指涨0.39%，道指微跌0.18%，全周下跌逾1.5%。10年期美债收益率在5%附近徘徊，交易员预期美联储将继续加息。摩根大通CEO戴蒙称通胀是否被战胜尚不明确。油价跌破100美元带来些许缓解，但未改变利率担忧。

news.titleEn: Bank of Japan raises interest rates to 31-year high, flags concerns over inflation
news.conclusionEn: The Bank of Japan lifted its policy rate to 1.25% from 1.0%, the highest in 31 years, by a 7-2 vote.
news.conclusionZh: 日本央行以7比2投票将利率从1.0%上调至1.25%，为31年来最高。
news.whyEn: Japan's shift away from ultra-low rates affects the yen, global bond yields and carry trades funded in yen.
news.whyZh: 日本告别超低利率，将影响日元、全球债券收益率及日元融资的套利交易。
news.detailEn: The BOJ said inflation risks overshooting its 2% target and that it is moving closer to what it considers a neutral rate. It was the first hike since June and was widely expected. Two board members appointed under Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi dissented. The move comes as rising wages and inflation, plus pressure from Washington, push Japan further from decades of ultra-low rates.
news.detailZh: 日本央行称通胀有超出2%目标的风险，并正逐步接近其认为的中性利率。这是6月以来首次加息，符合市场预期。两名由首相高市早苗任命的委员投了反对票。工资和通胀上升以及来自美国的压力，正推动日本进一步告别数十年的超低利率。

news.titleEn: Oil prices today: Brent, WTI, Saudi Arabia, Houthi
news.conclusionEn: Oil fell for a third day, with WTI closing near $100 and Brent near $104, as fears of lasting Saudi supply disruption eased.
news.conclusionZh: 油价连跌三日，WTI收于约100美元，布伦特约104美元，市场对沙特供应中断的担忧缓解。
news.whyEn: Oil near $100 keeps inflation elevated and shapes central bank decisions, while the Saudi-Houthi fighting widens the Middle East war.
news.whyZh: 接近100美元的油价使通胀居高不下并影响央行决策，沙特与胡塞武装的交火也扩大了中东战事。
news.detailEn: Prices had climbed toward four-month highs after Yanbu loadings were suspended and Riyadh cancelled some deliveries to Europe following damage to its East-West pipeline. Saudi Arabia is reportedly seeking to restore about half the pipeline capacity within days and is offering cargoes to Asian refiners via ship-to-ship transfers off Oman. Saudi Arabia and the Iran-backed Houthis exchanged fresh strikes, but markets largely shrugged them off.
news.detailZh: 此前因延布港装载暂停、沙特取消部分对欧交付且东西输油管道受损，油价一度逼近四个月高位。据报道，沙特正设法在数日内恢复约一半管道产能，并通过阿曼附近海域的船对船转运向亚洲炼厂供货。沙特与伊朗支持的胡塞武装再度互相袭击，但市场基本无视。

news.titleEn: Warren Buffett steps down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway: 'Father Time always wins'
news.conclusionEn: Warren Buffett stepped down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman, handing the role to his son Howard and becoming chairman emeritus.
news.conclusionZh: 巴菲特卸任伯克希尔董事长，由儿子霍华德接任，自己出任名誉董事长。
news.whyEn: It marks the next step in the succession of a $1 trillion conglomerate that Buffett led for more than six decades.
news.whyZh: 这是这家万亿美元集团在执掌逾六十年的巴菲特之后，权力交接的又一步。
news.detailEn: In a letter to shareholders, Buffett wrote that 'Father Time always wins' and said CEO Greg Abel has exceeded his expectations. Howard Buffett becomes chairman effective immediately, with a mandate to guard the company's culture and values. Abel already succeeded Warren Buffett as CEO. Coverage noted the stock has lagged the S&P 500 recently.
news.detailZh: 巴菲特在致股东信中写道「时间终将获胜」，并称CEO格雷格·阿贝尔的表现超出预期。霍华德·巴菲特即日起出任董事长，负责守护公司文化与价值观。阿贝尔此前已接任CEO。报道指出伯克希尔股价近期跑输标普500。

news.titleEn: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro line hits stores with a $100 price bump amid memory crunch, AI pressure
news.conclusionEn: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max went on sale $100 pricier, at $1,199 and $1,299, as AI demand drives a memory shortage.
news.conclusionZh: 苹果iPhone 18 Pro系列涨价100美元开售，起价1199和1299美元，AI需求推高内存短缺。
news.whyEn: It shows AI-driven memory shortages passing through to consumer electronics prices and squeezing device makers' margins.
news.whyZh: 这表明AI推动的内存短缺正传导至消费电子价格，并挤压设备厂商利润。
news.detailEn: These are the first new iPhones to launch amid a global AI-driven memory and storage shortage. Memory costs for the 256GB Pro are estimated to be nearly 400% higher than a year earlier, yet Apple is reportedly absorbing much of the increase. Delivery waits of about three weeks suggest demand remains strong. Apple is also said to be exploring alternative memory suppliers.
news.detailZh: 这是首批在AI带动的全球内存与存储短缺中发售的新iPhone。256GB Pro机型的内存成本预计同比上涨近400%，但据报道苹果自行消化了大部分涨幅。约三周的交付等待显示需求依然强劲。苹果据称也在寻找替代内存供应商。

businessTips.explanationEn: Opportunity cost is the value of the best alternative you give up when you choose one option. Every decision on time, money or people has one, even if no cash changes hands. Naming it makes trade-offs explicit and prevents low-value work from crowding out high-value work.
businessTips.explanationZh: 机会成本是你选择某一方案时所放弃的最佳替代方案的价值。时间、资金、人员上的每个决定都有机会成本，即使没有现金流出。把它说清楚能让取舍更透明，避免低价值工作挤占高价值工作。
businessTips.exampleEn: A manager spends 10 hours a week on manual reporting that a $200/month tool could automate. Those hours could go to winning clients worth far more, so the true cost of not automating is the lost sales.
businessTips.exampleZh: 经理每周花10小时手工做报表，而每月200美元的工具就能自动完成。这些时间本可用来拓展价值更高的客户，所以不自动化的真实代价是错失的销售额。

businessTips.explanationEn: Customer discovery means talking to potential customers before building, to learn their real problems and what they already do about them. Ask about past behavior rather than pitching your idea. It is the cheapest way to avoid building something nobody pays for.
businessTips.explanationZh: 客户发现访谈是在开发产品前先与潜在客户交流，了解他们真实的痛点以及现有解决办法。要问过去的行为，而不是推销你的想法。这是避免做出没人付费产品的最低成本方式。
businessTips.exampleEn: Before launching a side-hustle meal-prep service, interview 15 busy parents: how do they handle dinner now, what do they pay, what annoys them? If none has paid for a solution before, reconsider.
businessTips.exampleZh: 开展备餐副业前，先访谈15位忙碌的家长：现在怎么解决晚饭、花多少钱、最烦什么。如果没有人为此付过费，就该重新考虑。

businessTips.explanationEn: The yield curve plots bond yields across maturities, from short-term bills to 30-year bonds. Normally longer bonds yield more; when short-term yields exceed long-term ones it is called inversion and has often preceded recessions. It also reflects expectations for rates, inflation and growth.
businessTips.explanationZh: 收益率曲线描绘了从短期国债到30年期债券各期限的收益率。通常期限越长收益率越高；短端高于长端称为倒挂，历史上常先于经济衰退出现。它也反映市场对利率、通胀和增长的预期。
businessTips.exampleEn: With the 10-year yield near 5% after a Fed hike, investors watch whether it rises faster than short rates. A steepening curve can signal inflation worries and raise mortgage rates, which are tied to long yields.
businessTips.exampleZh: 美联储加息后10年期收益率接近5%，投资者关注它是否比短端利率上升更快。曲线变陡可能意味着通胀担忧，并推高与长期收益率挂钩的房贷利率。
